description: This is a Python Flask application that provides two API endpoints: one for a simple 'Hello World' message and another for serving JSON data from a file named 'eg5.json'. It includes error handling for file not found, JSON decode errors, and other exceptions.

methods.name: hello_world
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/api/helloWorld', returning a JSON message 'Hello World'.

methods.name: get_json
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/api/json', reads data from 'eg5.json', and returns it as JSON, with error handling for file not found, invalid JSON, and other exceptions.
